hooks.text: 武器与无人机自动射击，玩家仍要破解、冲刺和掐点放技能
hooks.excerpt: Your weapons and drones fight for you, auto-shooting the endless enemies. You'll still be busy though hacking devices, dashing out of bullet hells, and using timely special abilities!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 可购买追踪与爆炸词条，并把武器升级成巨型版本
hooks.excerpt: Weapons are also affected by buyable traits such as making all projectiles home-in or explode in boomy fires! Weapons can even be upgraded to form powerful mega weapons!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 主动技能甚至可召更多敌人，用风险换额外资源
hooks.excerpt: Equip abilities to manually trigger a variety of special effects, such as spawn friendly droids, heal, or spawn more enemies to boost your resources!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 界面切换时出现噪点般画面，观看不适。

excerpts.excerpt: 切换界面时画面会像噪点一样，看着不舒服
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 原有画风让老玩家感到熟悉。

excerpts.excerpt: 如同老家一般熟悉的画风
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 武器特质获取缺少自主性。

excerpts.excerpt: you have very little agency when it comes to acquiring these traits
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 该Boss缺乏创意且非常无聊

excerpts.excerpt: the least inspired and most boring boss I think I have ever faced
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 锁定物品可能占用商店选项

excerpts.excerpt: Your shop options can be taken up with locked items!
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 实际运行时很难看清哪些系统正在生效。

excerpts.excerpt: It's a bit hard to see what's actually working
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 多个系统操作别扭或缺乏乐趣。

excerpts.excerpt: Lots of systems exist in this game that are awkward or just unfun.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 内容量与独特性足以和前作区分。

excerpts.excerpt: lots of content and enough unique about it to differentiate itself from Boneraiser Minions
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 游戏节奏快且兼具乐趣与挑战。

excerpts.excerpt: The game moves pretty fast; a lot faster than many other games in the genre. Fun and challenging survivors-like.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段
